verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ships no SDKs of its own. It documents using Sentry's open-source client SDKs, aims for Sentry API compatibility, and provides SDK setup docs, so web apps can report errors (glitchtip-docs-1, -11, -28, -47, -50). Users confirm the Sentry libraries work reliably with it, including newer reporters such as Svelte (glitchtip-comm-1, -4). Native debug-symbol upload hints at native/mobile support (glitchtip-docs-22). Missing for 10: GlitchTip-official SDKs rather than third-party Sentry ones, explicit mobile SDK coverage, explicit documentation of automatic uncaught-error capture per platform, and a fix for frontend reports being blocked by ad-blockers (glitchtip-comm-5).
